data.gender_notes: Helge is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Old Norse word ‘helga’, meaning ‘holy’ or ‘sacred’, Helge has historical roots in Scandinavian paganism. The name signifies a hidden or concealed divine presence. In Christian context, Helge can be interpreted as a protector or guardian. The name Helge carries the meaning “Hidden, Concealed” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Helge usually hope their child will grow to embody hidden, concealed and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Helge total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.
